item.title: Guava: An Effective and Universal Harness for Embodied Manipulation
item.author: Liu, Haowen, Li, Xirui, Yao, Shaoxiong, Shi, Peng, Zhou, Tianyi, Huang, Jia-Bin, Huang, Furong, Mao, Jiayuan
item.description:
来源: hf | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为Guava的具身工具使用框架，通过系统探索智能体工作流、动作空间和观察空间的设计空间，识别出迭代感知推理动作循环、语义动作抽象和多模态观察三个关键要素。该框架通过端到端训练管道，将具身操作能力蒸馏到一个四十亿参数的开源模型中，仅使用少于两千条完全在模拟环境中收集的轨迹。实验结果表明，该模型在模拟和真实世界环境中表现可与前沿专有模型相媲美，并展现出对未见物体、新指令和长程任务的强大泛化能力。研究表明，设计良好的框架可作为可扩展且与模型无关的接口，使紧凑型开源模型在最小训练数据下也能展现出强大的涌现具身能力。

背景: 在大规模视觉语言数据上训练的语言模型在具身智能体方面展现出巨大潜力。通过具身工具使用来利用模型，结合高层推理与用于感知、规划和控制的外部模块，为端到端视觉语言动作系统提供了一种有前景的替代方案。然而，目前尚不清楚什么构成了有效的具身操作框架，以及此类框架能在多大程度上解锁广泛推理模型的具身能力。

目的: 探索并确定构成有效具身操作框架的关键设计要素，并验证这些设计原则是否适用于小型模型，从而开发出一种可扩展且与模型无关的具身操作接口。

方法: 提出Guava框架，通过系统探索智能体工作流、动作空间和观察空间的设计空间来构建。识别出迭代感知推理动作循环、语义动作抽象和多模态观察三个关键要素。开发了一个端到端训练管道，将具身操作能力蒸馏到一个四十亿参数的开源模型中，使用少于两千条完全在模拟环境中收集的轨迹进行训练。

主要发现: Guava框架在模拟和真实世界环境中均取得了与前沿专有模型相媲美的性能。该模型展现出对未见物体、新指令和长程任务的强大泛化能力。研究表明，设计良好的框架可以作为可扩展且与模型无关的接口，使紧凑型开源模型在最小训练数据下也能展现出强大的涌现具身能力。

结论: 设计良好的具身操作框架可以作为可扩展且与模型无关的接口，使紧凑型开源模型在最小训练数据下也能展现出强大的涌现具身能力，为具身智能体的发展提供了新的途径。

翻译: Language models trained on large-scale vision-language data have demonstrated strong potential for embodied agents. Harnessing models through embodied tools use offers a promising alternative to end-to-end vision-language-action systems by combining high-level reasoning with external modules for perception, planning, and control. However, it remains unclear what makes an effective harness for embodied manipulation, and to what extent such a harness can unlock embodied capabilities in a wide range of reasoning models. In this work, we present Guava, a harness framework for embodied tool use developed through systematic exploration of the design space of agent workflows, action spaces, and observation spaces. Our study identifies three key ingredients for effective embodied agents: iterative perception-reasoning-action loops, semantic action abstractions, and multimodal observations. To understand whether these design principles are universal even to small models, we develop an end-to-end training pipeline that distills embodied manipulation capabilities into a 4B open-source model using fewer than 2K trajectories collected entirely in simulation. Experimental results in both simulation and real-world environments show performance comparable to frontier proprietary models while exhibiting strong generalization to unseen objects, novel instructions, and long-horizon tasks. Results suggest that a well-designed harness can serve as a scalable, model-agnostic interface for embodied manipulation, enabling strong emergent embodied capabilities in compact open-source models with minimal training data.

Abstract

Language models trained on large-scale vision-language data have demonstrated strong potential for embodied agents. Harnessing models through embodied tools use offers a promising alternative to end-to-end vision-language-action systems by combining high-level reasoning with external modules for perception, planning, and control. However, it remains unclear what makes an effective harness for embodied manipulation, and to what extent such a harness can unlock embodied capabilities in a wide range of reasoning models. In this work, we present Guava, a harness framework for embodied tool use developed through systematic exploration of the design space of agent workflows, action spaces, and observation spaces. Our study identifies three key ingredients for effective embodied agents: iterative perception-reasoning-action loops, semantic action abstractions, and multimodal observations. To understand whether these design principles are universal even to small models, we develop an end-to-end training pipeline that distills embodied manipulation capabilities into a 4B open-source model using fewer than 2K trajectories collected entirely in simulation. Experimental results in both simulation and real-world environments show performance comparable to frontier proprietary models while exhibiting strong generalization to unseen objects, novel instructions, and long-horizon tasks. Results suggest that a well-designed harness can serve as a scalable, model-agnostic interface for embodied manipulation, enabling strong emergent embodied capabilities in compact open-source models with minimal training data.

item.title: PAIWorld: A 3D-Consistent World Foundation Model for Robotic Manipulation
item.author: Yuhang Huang, Xuan Lv, Junyan Xu, Zhiyuan Yu, Jiazhao Zhang, Ruizhen Hu, Wancheng Feng, Shilong Zou, Hewen Xiao, Ziqiao Zhou, Kaiyun Huang, Zhiyu Peng, Juzhan Xu, Hang Zhao, Chenyang Zhu, Renjiao Yi, Yifei Huang, Douhui Wu, Yan Zhang, Kexu Cheng, Chunhe Song, Yunzhi Xue, Xiuhong Zhang, Leitao Guo, Yunji Chen, Bin Wu, Haibin Yu, Kai Xu
item.description:
来源: arxiv;hf | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出PAIWorld框架，通过引入显式跨视图通信机制和三维几何先验，解决了世界基础模型在多视角机器人操作中存在的跨视图物体漂移、深度不一致和纹理错位问题，实现了最先进的多视角三维一致性。

背景: 世界基础模型是强大的模拟器，但主要在单视角下运行，缺乏机器人操作所需的多视角三维一致性。当前多视角世界模型简单拼接视图标记，缺乏显式几何推理，导致跨视图物体漂移、深度不一致和纹理错位。

目的: 解决世界基础模型在多视角机器人操作中缺乏多视角三维一致性的问题，通过同时引入显式跨视图通信机制和三维几何先验来消除跨视图物体漂移、深度不一致和纹理错位。

方法: 提出PAIWorld框架，基于扩散变换器世界模型，包含三个核心组件：几何感知跨视图注意力块建立跨视图显式路径；几何旋转位置编码将相机射线方向和外部姿态编码到注意力机制中；潜在三维REPA从冻结的三维基础模型中蒸馏三维感知特征以确保三维一致性。

主要发现: PAIWorld在机器人操作基准测试中实现了最先进的多视角三维一致性，在WorldArena排行榜排名第一，在AgiBot-Challenge2026排行榜排名第二，并支持基于模型的规划、世界动作模型和多视角策略后训练等下游应用。

结论: 同时引入显式跨视图通信机制和三维几何先验是解决世界基础模型多视角一致性的必要且充分条件，PAIWorld框架有效提升了多视角三维一致性并支持多种下游应用。

翻译: World foundation models (WFMs) are powerful simulators, yet they predominantly operate in a single-view setting and lack the multi-view 3D consistency required for robotic manipulation. While robotic systems rely on multiple cameras (egocentric, eye-to-hand, and wrist-mounted) for policy learning, current multi-view world models simply concatenate view tokens without explicit geometric reasoning. This causes cross-view object drift, depth inconsistency, and texture misalignment. We trace these failures to two deficiencies: the absence of an explicit inter-view communication mechanism and the lack of a 3D geometric prior. We argue that resolving both simultaneously is necessary and sufficient. To address this, we present PAIWorld, a framework that augments diffusion-transformer world models via three core components: (1) Geometry-Aware Cross-View Attention blocks that establish an explicit pathway across views, (2) Geometric Rotary Position Embedding that encodes camera ray directions and extrinsic poses into the attention mechanism, and (3) Latent 3D-REPA, which distills 3D-aware features from frozen 3D foundation models to ensure 3D consistency. Built upon a DiT-based world foundation model, PAIWorld achieves state-of-the-art multi-view 3D consistency on robotic manipulation benchmarks, ranking 1st on the WorldArena leaderboard and 2nd on the AgiBot-Challenge2026 leaderboard, while enabling downstream applications such as model-based planning, world action models, and multi-view policy post-training.

Abstract

World foundation models (WFMs) are powerful simulators, yet they predominantly operate in a single-view setting and lack the multi-view 3D consistency required for robotic manipulation. While robotic systems rely on multiple cameras (egocentric, eye-to-hand, and wrist-mounted) for policy learning, current multi-view world models simply concatenate view tokens without explicit geometric reasoning. This causes cross-view object drift, depth inconsistency, and texture misalignment. We trace these failures to two deficiencies: the absence of an explicit inter-view communication mechanism and the lack of a 3D geometric prior. We argue that resolving both simultaneously is necessary and sufficient. To address this, we present PAIWorld, a framework that augments diffusion-transformer world models via three core components: (1) Geometry-Aware Cross-View Attention blocks that establish an explicit pathway across views, (2) Geometric Rotary Position Embedding that encodes camera ray directions and extrinsic poses into the attention mechanism, and (3) Latent 3D-REPA, which distills 3D-aware features from frozen 3D foundation models to ensure 3D consistency. Built upon a DiT-based world foundation model, PAIWorld achieves state-of-the-art multi-view 3D consistency on robotic manipulation benchmarks, ranking 1st on the WorldArena leaderboard and 2nd on the AgiBot-Challenge2026 leaderboard, while enabling downstream applications such as model-based planning, world action models, and multi-view policy post-training.

item.title: CAOA -- Completion-Assisted Object-CAD Alignment
item.author: Hiranya Garbha Kumar, Minhas Kamal, Balakrishnan Prabhakaran
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为CAOA的方法，用于将CAD模型与室内RGB-D扫描中的物体精确对齐。该方法结合了点云补全模块和对称性感知相对位姿估计算法，通过引入针对室内场景的合成数据生成策略和专家标注数据集S2C-Completion，解决了现有方法在真实扫描中泛化能力不足的问题。在Scan2CAD基准测试中，CAOA的准确率比现有最先进方法提高了百分之十七。

背景: 在三维语义重建中，将CAD模型与室内RGB-D扫描中的对应物体精确对齐是一个核心挑战。该任务需要估计九自由度的位姿、旋转和缩放，但受到噪声和不完整扫描以及导致几何畸变的分割错误的阻碍。现有的点云补全方法通常在合成数据集上训练和评估，难以泛化到真实扫描。

目的: 提出一种能够精确对齐CAD模型到扫描物体的方法，解决现有补全方法在真实场景中泛化能力不足的问题，并提升对齐的鲁棒性。

方法: 提出Completion-Assisted Object-CAD Alignment方法，集成语义和上下文感知的点云补全模块与对称性感知相对位姿估计算法。引入针对室内场景的合成数据生成策略以缩小合成到真实的领域差距，并发布了包含超过八千五百个物体-CAD对的专家标注数据集S2C-Completion。在物体-CAD对齐中，通过引入对称性感知损失来利用对称性信息，提高对对称歧义的鲁棒性。

主要发现: 提出的合成数据生成策略有效缩小了合成到真实的领域差距。在Scan2CAD基准测试中，CAOA方法实现了百分之十七的准确率提升，优于现有最先进方法。

结论: CAOA方法通过结合点云补全和对称性感知对齐，有效解决了CAD模型与室内扫描物体对齐的挑战，为真实室内单物体补全提供了新的基准数据集。

翻译: Accurately aligning CAD models to their corresponding objects in indoor RGB-D scans is a central challenge in 3D semantic reconstruction. The task requires estimating a 9-Degree-of-Freedom pose-position, rotation, and scale along three axes-but is hindered by noisy and incomplete scans, as well as segmentation errors that cause geometric distortions. We present Completion-Assisted Object-CAD Alignment, a method that integrates a semantically and contextually aware point cloud completion module with a symmetry-aware relative pose estimation algorithm, enabling precise alignment of CAD models to scanned objects. Existing completion methods are typically trained and evaluated on synthetic datasets, which often fail to generalize to real-world scans. To bridge this gap, we introduce a synthetic data generation strategy tailored to indoor scenes, significantly reducing the synthetic-to-real domain gap-validated through quantitative comparisons with widely used completion datasets. In addition, we release S2C-Completion, an expert-annotated dataset of over 8,500 object-CAD pairs from Scan2CAD, created for real-world indoor single-object completion and intended as a new benchmark for this task. For object-CAD alignment, we incorporate symmetry information via a symmetry-aware loss, improving robustness to symmetric ambiguities. On the Scan2CAD benchmark, CAOA achieves a 17% accuracy improvement over state-of-the-art methods.

Abstract

Accurately aligning CAD models to their corresponding objects in indoor RGB-D scans is a central challenge in 3D semantic reconstruction. The task requires estimating a 9-Degree-of-Freedom (DoF) pose-position, rotation, and scale along three axes-but is hindered by noisy and incomplete scans, as well as segmentation errors that cause geometric distortions. We present Completion-Assisted Object-CAD Alignment (CAOA), a method that integrates a semantically and contextually aware point cloud completion module with a symmetry-aware relative pose estimation algorithm, enabling precise alignment of CAD models to scanned objects. Existing completion methods are typically trained and evaluated on synthetic datasets, which often fail to generalize to real-world scans. To bridge this gap, we introduce a synthetic data generation strategy tailored to indoor scenes, significantly reducing the synthetic-to-real domain gap-validated through quantitative comparisons with widely used completion datasets. In addition, we release S2C-Completion, an expert-annotated dataset of over 8,500 object-CAD pairs from Scan2CAD, created for real-world indoor single-object completion and intended as a new benchmark for this task. For object-CAD alignment, we incorporate symmetry information via a symmetry-aware loss, improving robustness to symmetric ambiguities. On the Scan2CAD benchmark, CAOA achieves a 17% accuracy improvement over state-of-the-art methods.

item.title: Domain Generalizable Adaptation of 3D Vision-Language Models via Regularized Fine-Tuning
item.author: Sneha Paul, Zachary Patterson, Nizar Bouguila
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: ReFine3D是一种用于3D大型多模态模型领域泛化微调的框架，通过选择性层调优和两种针对性正则化策略（多视图一致性和文本多样性）提升模型性能，并在多个基准测试中优于现有方法。

背景: 3D视觉中的领域适应是一个核心挑战，特别是在对齐3D点云与视觉和文本数据的多模态基础模型中。这些模型虽然具备强大的通用能力，但在数据有限的下游领域进行微调时，容易导致过拟合和灾难性遗忘。

目的: 解决3D大型多模态模型在领域适应过程中面临的过拟合和灾难性遗忘问题，实现领域泛化的微调。

方法: 提出ReFine3D框架，结合选择性层调优与两种正则化策略：基于增强点云的多视图一致性，以及通过大语言模型生成的同义词提示实现的文本多样性。此外，引入点渲染视觉监督和基于置信度的测试时数据增强机制以增强鲁棒性。

主要发现: 在多个3D领域泛化基准测试中，ReFine3D将基础到新颖类的泛化能力提升1.36%，跨数据集迁移能力提升2.43%，对损坏的鲁棒性提升1.80%，少样本准确率最高提升3.11%，且计算开销极小。

结论: ReFine3D通过结合选择性微调与正则化策略，有效提升了3D多模态模型的领域泛化能力和鲁棒性，在保持低计算成本的同时优于现有最先进方法。

翻译: 领域适应仍然是3D视觉中的一个核心挑战，特别是对于将3D点云与视觉和文本数据对齐的多模态基础模型。虽然这些模型展现出强大的通用能力，但在数据有限的下游领域进行微调时，往往会导致过拟合和灾难性遗忘。为了解决这一问题，我们引入了ReFine3D，这是一个专为3D大型多模态模型领域泛化微调设计的正则化微调框架。ReFine3D结合了选择性层调优与两种针对性的正则化策略：跨增强点云的多视图一致性，以及通过大语言模型生成的同义词提示实现的文本多样性。此外，我们还引入了点渲染视觉监督和基于置信度的测试时数据增强机制，以进一步增强鲁棒性。在不同3D领域泛化基准上的大量实验表明，ReFine3D将基础到新颖类的泛化能力提高了1.36%，跨数据集迁移能力提高了2.43%，对损坏的鲁棒性提高了1.80%，少样本准确率最高提高了3.11%，在计算开销极小的情况下优于现有的最先进方法。

Abstract

Domain adaptation remains a central challenge in 3D vision, especially for multimodal foundation models that align 3D point clouds with visual and textual data. While these models demonstrate strong general capabilities, adapting them to downstream domains with limited data often leads to overfitting and catastrophic forgetting. To address this, we introduce ReFine3D, a regularized fine-tuning framework designed for domain-generalizable tuning of 3D large multimodal models (LMMs). ReFine3D combines selective layer tuning with two targeted regularization strategies: multi-view consistency across augmented point clouds and text diversity through synonym-based prompts generated by large language models. Additionally, we incorporate point-rendered vision supervision and a test-time augmentation mechanism with confidence-based aggregation to further enhance robustness. Extensive experiments across different 3D domain generalization benchmarks show that ReFine3D improves base-to-novel class generalization by 1.36%, cross-dataset transfer by 2.43%, robustness to corruption by 1.80%, and few-shot accuracy by up to 3.11%, outperforming prior state-of-the-art methods with minimal added computational overhead.

item.title: MolmoMotion: Forecasting Point Trajectories in 3D with Language Instruction
item.author: Jianing Zhang, Chenhao Zheng, Yajun Yang, Max Argus, Rustin Soraki, Winson Han, Taira Anderson, Chun-Liang Li, Shuo Liu, Jiafei Duan, Zhongzheng Ren, Jieyu Zhang, Ranjay Krishna
item.description:
来源: arxiv;hf | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种基于三维世界坐标点的通用运动预测方法，构建了大规模数据集和基准测试，并开发了一个支持自回归坐标预测和流匹配轨迹生成的运动预测模型，该模型在预测多样运动模式方面表现优异，且其学习到的三维运动先验能有效迁移至机器人操作和视频生成等下游任务。

背景: 运动预测是视觉智能的核心，智能体必须预测物体的运动以规划行动、推理物理交互并合成逼真的未来场景。

目的: 形式化目标条件的三维点运动预测任务，即给定短期视觉历史、感兴趣物体上的三维查询点集以及语言描述的目标意图，预测每个点的未来三维轨迹。

方法: 构建了包含大规模动作描述和物体定位的三维点轨迹数据集MolmoMotion-1M，建立了涵盖多个物体类别和运动类型的人类验证基准测试PointMotionBench，并提出了通用运动预测模型MolmoMotion，支持自回归坐标预测和基于流匹配的轨迹生成。

主要发现: MolmoMotion能够准确预测不同语言指令下的多样运动模式，在PointMotionBench基准测试中显著优于现有的运动预测基线模型。

结论: 学习到的三维运动先验能有效迁移到下游应用，提高了机器人操作的训练效率和泛化能力，并为生成模型提供了有效的运动引导，以合成具有更逼真物体运动的视频。

翻译: Motion forecasting is central to visual intelligence: agents must anticipate how objects will move in order to plan actions, reason about physical interactions, and synthesize realistic futures. We argue that 3D points in world coordinates provide a general representation that is class-agnostic, view-stable, compact, and directly useful for downstream tasks. We formalize the task of goal-conditioned 3D point motion forecasting: given a short visual history, a set of 3D query points on an object of interest, and a language description of the intended goal, the model predicts the future 3D trajectory of each point. We introduce a full stack to study this task at scale: (1) MolmoMotion-1M is a large corpus of action-described, object-grounded 3D point trajectories annotated from 1.16M unconstrained videos; (2) PointMotionBench is a human-verified benchmark spanning 111 object categories and 61 motion types; and (3) MolmoMotion is a general motion forecasting model that supports both autoregressive coordinate prediction and flow-matching-based trajectory generation. MolmoMotion accurately predicts diverse motion patterns with different language instructions, and significantly outperforms existing motion prediction baselines on PointMotionBench. Finally, we show that the learned 3D motion prior transfers well to downstream applications: it improves training efficiency and generalization for robot manipulation, and its predicted trajectories provide effective motion guidance for generative models to synthesize videos with more realistic object motion.

Abstract

Motion forecasting is central to visual intelligence: agents must anticipate how objects will move in order to plan actions, reason about physical interactions, and synthesize realistic futures. We argue that 3D points in world coordinates provide a general representation that is class-agnostic, view-stable, compact, and directly useful for downstream tasks. We formalize the task of goal-conditioned 3D point motion forecasting: given a short visual history, a set of 3D query points on an object of interest, and a language description of the intended goal, the model predicts the future 3D trajectory of each point. We introduce a full stack to study this task at scale: (1) MolmoMotion-1M is a large corpus of action-described, object-grounded 3D point trajectories annotated from 1.16M unconstrained videos; (2) PointMotionBench is a human-verified benchmark spanning 111 object categories and 61 motion types; and (3) MolmoMotion is a general motion forecasting model that supports both autoregressive coordinate prediction and flow-matching-based trajectory generation. MolmoMotion accurately predicts diverse motion patterns with different language instructions, and significantly outperforms existing motion prediction baselines on PointMotionBench. Finally, we show that the learned 3D motion prior transfers well to downstream applications: it improves training efficiency and generalization for robot manipulation, and its predicted trajectories provide effective motion guidance for generative models to synthesize videos with more realistic object motion.

item.title: Intrinsic 4D Gaussian Segmentation from Scene Cues
item.author: Hasan Yazar, Mohamed Rayan Barhdadi, Erchin Serpedin, Mehmet Tuncel, Hasan Kurban
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为Intrinsic-GS的无训练、无掩码方法，用于动态4D高斯泼溅场景的分割。该方法通过构建基于外观、方向、尺度、变形轨迹及渲染边界线索的稀疏亲和图，并利用Leiden社区检测算法进行分区，从而从高斯基元自身恢复物体级结构。

背景: 动态4D高斯泼溅技术被广泛用于重建高保真变形场景。然而，在编辑、操作或运动分析等应用中，首先需要对场景进行分割，即将高斯基元分组为连贯的物体。现有方法通常依赖从基础模型导入二维掩码并提升或蒸馏到高斯表示中，这在动态场景中需要跨多帧和视图生成掩码，成本高昂且结果受外部掩码质量影响大。

目的: 探讨如何仅从高斯基元自身恢复物体级结构，提出一种无需外部掩码监督、无需基础模型且无需学习特征场的分割方法。

方法: 提出Intrinsic-GS方法，该方法无需训练且无需掩码。它从高斯基元的外观、方向、尺度、变形轨迹和非学习渲染边界线索构建稀疏亲和图，并使用Leiden社区检测算法对图进行分区。

主要发现: 在标准4D高斯分割基准Neu3D和HyperNeRF上，Intrinsic-GS无需掩码监督即可恢复显著的物体结构，在Neu3D上达到0.746的mIoU，在HyperNeRF上达到0.575的mIoU。在Neu3D上，仅几何变体达到0.902的mIoU，与SAM监督的TRASE相当。在HyperNeRF上，Intrinsic-GS比掩码监督流水线中的掩码生成和特征渲染阶段快12.5倍。

结论: 分割信号很大程度上已编码在高斯基元自身中。Intrinsic-GS提供了一种快速、无掩码的3D和4D高斯分割方向，可能在外部掩码不可靠或昂贵的场景中实现更通用、更鲁棒的分割。

翻译: Dynamic 4D Gaussian Splatting reconstructs deforming scenes with high fidelity and is increasingly adopted as a representation for dynamic 3D scenes. Putting such a scene to use, for editing, manipulation or motion analysis, first requires segmenting it: grouping the Gaussian primitives into coherent objects. Current pipelines obtain this grouping by importing 2D masks from foundation models such as SAM and lifting or distilling them into the Gaussian representation. In dynamic scenes these masks must be generated across many frames and views, which is costly, and the resulting segmentation can depend strongly on the quality and consistency of those external masks. We ask how much object-level structure can instead be recovered from the Gaussians themselves, and propose Intrinsic-GS, a training-free, mask-free method that builds a sparse affinity graph over Gaussian primitives from appearance, orientation, scale, deformation-trajectory and non-learned rendered-boundary cues. The graph is partitioned with Leiden community detection, requiring no foundation model and no learned feature field. On the standard 4D Gaussian segmentation benchmarks, Neu3D and HyperNeRF, Intrinsic-GS recovers substantial object structure without mask supervision, reaching 0.746 mIoU on Neu3D and 0.575 on HyperNeRF; on Neu3D, a geometry-only variant reaches 0.902 mIoU, matching SAM-supervised TRASE. On HyperNeRF, Intrinsic-GS runs 12.5x faster than the mask-generation and feature-rendering stages used by mask-supervised pipelines. These results suggest that much of the segmentation signal is already encoded in the Gaussians themselves, offering a fast, mask-free direction for 3D and 4D Gaussian segmentation that may also point toward more generalizable, robust segmentation in settings where external masks are unreliable or expensive.

Abstract

Dynamic 4D Gaussian Splatting reconstructs deforming scenes with high fidelity and is increasingly adopted as a representation for dynamic 3D scenes. Putting such a scene to use, for editing, manipulation or motion analysis, first requires segmenting it: grouping the Gaussian primitives into coherent objects. Current pipelines obtain this grouping by importing 2D masks from foundation models such as SAM and lifting or distilling them into the Gaussian representation. In dynamic scenes these masks must be generated across many frames and views, which is costly, and the resulting segmentation can depend strongly on the quality and consistency of those external masks. We ask how much object-level structure can instead be recovered from the Gaussians themselves, and propose Intrinsic-GS, a training-free, mask-free method that builds a sparse affinity graph over Gaussian primitives from appearance, orientation, scale, deformation-trajectory and non-learned rendered-boundary cues. The graph is partitioned with Leiden community detection, requiring no foundation model and no learned feature field. On the standard 4D Gaussian segmentation benchmarks, Neu3D and HyperNeRF, Intrinsic-GS recovers substantial object structure without mask supervision, reaching 0.746 mIoU on Neu3D and 0.575 on HyperNeRF; on Neu3D, a geometry-only variant reaches 0.902 mIoU, matching SAM-supervised TRASE. On HyperNeRF, Intrinsic-GS runs 12.5x faster than the mask-generation and feature-rendering stages used by mask-supervised pipelines. These results suggest that much of the segmentation signal is already encoded in the Gaussians themselves, offering a fast, mask-free direction for 3D and 4D Gaussian segmentation that may also point toward more generalizable, robust segmentation in settings where external masks are unreliable or expensive.

item.title: DINO-Med3D: Bridging Dimension and Domain Gaps in Volumetric Segmentation via Progressive Adaptation
item.author: Haoyu Hu, Xiyao Ma, Shiqi Liu, Linsen Zhang, Xiaoliang Xie, Xiaohu Zhou, Zeng-Guang Hou
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为DINO-Med3D的两阶段渐进式框架，旨在将预训练的DINOv3编码器应用于三维医学图像分割任务。该框架通过引入多切片嵌入模块、轻量级三维适配器和并行细节恢复流，解决了自然图像与医学图像在维度和领域上的差异问题。

背景: 尽管DINOv3在自然图像语义判别方面表现出色，但其直接应用于三维医学分割任务会受到固有的维度和领域差异的阻碍。

目的: 解决DINOv3在三维医学分割任务中因维度和领域差异导致的应用障碍，成功将DINOv3适配到医学领域。

方法: 提出DINO-Med3D框架，包含三个阶段：首先引入多切片嵌入模块以缓解维度差距，并通过分割代理任务将自然场景学到的表示适应到医学领域；其次在冻结的主干网络中添加轻量级三维适配器以增强体积理解并保证切片间的连续性；最后设计并行细节恢复流以补偿嵌入过程中的空间信息损失，保留高频边界线索。

主要发现: 在五个公共数据集上的广泛实验表明，该方法成功将DINOv3适配到医学领域，并显著优于最先进的基础模型。

结论: DINO-Med3D框架有效解决了DINOv3在三维医学分割中的适配问题，提升了分割性能。

翻译: 尽管DINOv3在自然图像中展示了卓越的语义判别能力，但其直接应用于体积医学分割受到固有维度和领域差异的阻碍。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了DINO-Med3D，这是一个两阶段渐进式框架，重新利用了预训练的DINOv3编码器用于三维医学任务。在第一阶段，我们通过引入一个包含伪三维上下文的多切片嵌入模块来弥合维度差距，同时采用分割代理任务将自然场景中学到的表示适应到医学领域。随后，我们通过向冻结的主干网络中添加轻量级三维适配器来进一步增强体积理解，以强制执行全局切片间连续性。最后，为了补偿嵌入过程中固有的空间信息损失，我们设计了一个并行细节恢复流来显式保留高频边界线索。在五个公共数据集上的广泛实验表明，我们的方法成功地将DINOv3适配到医学领域，并显著优于最先进的基础模型。

Abstract

Although DINOv3 has demonstrated remarkable semantic discrimination in natural imagery, its direct application to volumetric medical segmentation is hindered by inherent dimension and domain disparities. To resolve these issues, we propose DINO-Med3D, a two-stage progressive framework that repurpose the pre-trained DINOv3 encoder for 3D medical tasks. In the first stage, we mitigate the dimension gap by introducing a multi-slice embedding module that incorporates pseudo-3D context, while simultaneously employing a segmentation proxy task to adapt representations learned from natural scenes to the medical domain. Subsequently, we further enhance volumetric understanding by adding lightweight 3D adapters into the frozen backbone to enforce global inter-slice continuity. Finally, to compensate for the spatial information loss inherent in the embedding process, we design a parallel detail recovery stream to explicitly preserve high-frequency boundary cues. Extensive experiments on five public datasets demonstrate that our approach successfully adapts DINOv3 to the medical domain and significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines.

item.title: C-ARC: Continuous-Adaptive Range Clustering for Non-Repetitive LiDAR Sensors
item.author: Nick B. Schroeder, Jonathan Lichtenfeld, Oskar von Stryk
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为C-ARC的连续自适应范围聚类框架，旨在解决非重复式激光雷达传感器在点云聚类中面临的挑战，该框架通过维护滑动窗口上的持久双图结构，实现了高频点插入与按需聚类检索的解耦，并在Livox Mid-360和Avia传感器数据上进行了实时性能评估。

背景: 实时激光雷达聚类是移动机器人算法的重要前提。当前方法主要面向重复式机械激光雷达传感器，但非重复式激光雷达传感器因成本低、体积小而使用日益增多。这类基于Risley棱镜的非重复式传感器违反了重复式传感器的两个关键假设：结构化扫描线和明确定义的帧边界。其Rhodonea曲线轨迹导致点分布不均匀，且缺乏旋转周期使得传统的扫描线索引方法失效。

目的: 为满足非重复式激光雷达传感器的新需求，开发一种能够处理非均匀点分布和无帧边界问题的聚类框架，以支持SLAM或跟踪等关键功能。

方法: 开发了C-ARC（连续自适应范围聚类）框架。该框架在滑动窗口上维护持久双图结构，将高频点插入与按需聚类检索解耦。采用自适应范围网格分辨率机制，在初始化时使用指数控制回路校准网格尺寸，以在无需预先了解扫描模式的情况下平衡稀疏性与碰撞的权衡。该框架实现为开源的单线程C++17库。

主要发现: C-ARC在商用硬件上对Livox Mid-360传感器实现了20 Hz的实时聚类输出。在Livox Avia传感器上的评估表明，对于扫描模式高度集中的传感器，无界单元格占用是主要限制。此外，自适应分辨率机制还提高了现有基于网格的方法在非重复数据上的聚类质量。

结论: C-ARC框架能够有效处理非重复式激光雷达传感器的聚类问题，提供实时输出，并改善了现有方法在非重复数据上的性能，尽管对于扫描模式高度集中的传感器仍存在无界单元格占用的限制。

翻译: 实时激光雷达聚类识别点云中的结构，这是许多移动机器人算法的基本前提。目前的方法大多是为重复式机械激光雷达传感器开发的。最近，由于其成本低和体积小，非重复式激光雷达传感器的使用正在迅速增加。这类基于Risley棱镜的非重复式传感器违反了重复式机械传感器的两个关键假设：结构化扫描线和明确定义的帧边界。它们的Rhodonea曲线轨迹产生非均匀的点分布，而缺乏旋转周期使得传统的扫描线索引不可用。为了满足这些新要求，我们开发了C-ARC，一种连续自适应范围聚类框架，它在滑动窗口上维护持久双图结构，将高频点插入与按需聚类检索解耦。这对于SLAM或跟踪等关键功能至关重要。自适应范围网格分辨率机制在初始化时使用指数控制回路校准网格尺寸，在无需预先了解扫描模式的情况下平衡稀疏性与碰撞的权衡。作为开源的单线程C++17库实现，C-ARC在商用硬件上对Livox Mid-360实现了20赫兹的实时聚类输出。在Livox Avia上的评估确定了无界单元格占用是扫描模式高度集中的传感器的主要限制。自适应分辨率机制还提高了现有基于网格的方法在非重复数据上的聚类质量。

Abstract

Real-time LiDAR clustering identifies structures in point clouds, which is an essential prerequisite for many mobile robotics algorithms. Current methods are mostly developed for repetitive mechanical LiDAR sensors. Recently, the use of non-repetitive LiDAR sensors is strongly increasing due to their small cost and form factor. Such non-repetitive Risley prism-based sensors violate two key assumptions of repetitive mechanical sensors: structured scan lines and well-defined frame boundaries. Their Rhodonea-curve trajectories produce non-uniform point distributions, and the absence of a rotation cycle renders conventional scan line indexing inapplicable. To meet such new requirements, we developed C-ARC, a Continuous-Adaptive Range Clustering framework that maintains a persistent dual-graph over a sliding window, decoupling high-frequency point insertion from on-demand cluster retrieval. This is crucial for key functionalities like SLAM or tracking. An adaptive range grid resolution mechanism calibrates grid dimensions at initialization using an exponential control loop, balancing the sparsity-collision trade-off without prior knowledge of the scanning pattern. Implemented as an open-sourced single-threaded C++17 library, C-ARC produces real-time cluster output at 20 Hz on commodity hardware for the Livox Mid-360. Evaluation on the Livox Avia identifies unbounded cell occupancy as the primary limitation for sensors with strongly concentrated scan patterns. The adaptive resolution mechanism additionally improves clustering quality for existing grid-based methods on non-repetitive data.

item.title: TactSpace: Learning a Physics-enriched Shared Latent Space for Tactile Sim-to-Real Transfer
item.author: Arunim Joarder, Arjun Bhardwaj, René Zurbrügg, Mayank Mittal, Florin Püntener, Sira Bielefeldt, Cosmin Roman, Vaishakh Patil, Marco Hutter
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

summary: 提出了一种多模态表示学习框架，通过在共享潜在空间中对齐异构触觉模态，解决了当前仿真器缺乏保真度导致仿真到现实迁移困难的问题。该方法使用特定模态的编码器将不同触觉观测投影到共同嵌入空间，并通过自重建、交叉重建和对比对齐进行训练。实验表明，该方法在压头形状识别、力预测和几何重建任务上实现了零样本仿真到现实的迁移，并显著降低了误差。最后，发布了一个基于Warp的触觉仿真模型实现，用于Isaac Lab。

background: 触觉传感提供机器人操作所需的接触相互作用直接测量。然而，当前仿真器缺乏保真度，无法准确模拟触觉传感器的复杂变形和转换机制，严重阻碍了机器人学习管道中的仿真到现实迁移。

purpose: 解决当前仿真器缺乏保真度导致仿真到现实迁移困难的问题，消除对准确原始信号仿真的需求，同时保留相关接触信息。

method: 提出了一种多模态表示学习框架，使用特定模态的编码器将不同触觉观测（如仿真穿透深度和现实电容）投影到共同嵌入空间。模型通过自重建、交叉重建目标和对比对齐进行训练，鼓励模态不变且信息丰富的表示。

main_finding: 在压头形状识别、力预测和几何重建任务上，该方法实现了零样本仿真到现实的迁移。结合多物理仿真模态产生了信息更丰富的嵌入，在力预测误差上降低了百分之十六点七，在形状重建误差上降低了百分之四十五点八。

conclusion: 所提出的多模态表示学习框架有效解决了仿真到现实迁移问题，显著提升了触觉感知任务的性能，并提供了高效的触觉数据生成工具。

translation: 触觉传感提供机器人操作所需的接触相互作用直接测量。然而，当前仿真器缺乏保真度，无法准确模拟触觉传感器的复杂变形和转换机制，严重阻碍了机器人学习管道中的仿真到现实迁移。为解决这一挑战，我们提出了一种多模态表示学习框架，通过在共享潜在空间中对齐异构触觉模态，消除对准确原始信号仿真的需求，同时保留相关接触信息。我们的方法使用特定模态的编码器将不同触觉观测（如仿真穿透深度和现实电容）投影到共同嵌入空间。模型通过自重建、交叉重建目标和对比对齐进行训练，鼓励模态不变且信息丰富的表示。我们在压头形状识别、力预测和几何重建任务上评估了学习到的嵌入，仅在仿真中训练，直接在现实传感器测量上测试。我们的结果表明，该方法在物理上不同的表示上实现了零样本仿真到现实的迁移。此外，结合多物理仿真模态产生了信息更丰富的嵌入，在力预测误差上降低了百分之十六点七，在形状重建误差上降低了百分之四十五点八。最后，我们发布了一个基于Warp的触觉仿真模型实现，用于Isaac Lab，实现了可扩展的触觉数据生成。

Abstract

Tactile sensing provides direct measurements of contact interactions that are essential for robotic manipulation. However, current simulators lack the fidelity to faithfully model the complex deformation and transduction mechanics of tactile sensors, severely hindering sim-to-real transfer in robot learning pipelines. To address this challenge, we propose a multi-modal representation learning framework that aligns heterogeneous tactile modalities within a shared latent space, eliminating the need for accurate raw-signal simulation while preserving relevant contact information. Our approach employs modality-specific encoders to project diverse tactile observations, such as simulated penetration depth and real-world capacitance, into a common embedding space. The model is trained using self- and cross-reconstruction objectives alongside contrastive alignment, encouraging modality-invariant yet information-rich representations. We evaluate the learned embeddings on indenter shape identification, force prediction, and geometric reconstruction tasks, training exclusively in simulation and testing directly on real sensor measurements. Our results demonstrate zero-shot sim-to-real transfer across physically dissimilar representations. Furthermore, incorporating multi-physics simulation modalities yields more informative embeddings that transfer across diverse downstream tasks, demonstrating a 16.7% reduction in force prediction error and a 45.8% reduction in shape reconstruction error. Finally, we release an efficient Warp-based implementation of a penalty-based tactile simulation model for Isaac Lab, enabling scalable tactile data generation.

item.title: Seeing Before Reasoning: Decoupling Perception and Reasoning for Shortcut-Resilient Multimodal On-Policy Self-Distillation
item.author: Wang, Sihan, Liu, Xiyao, Liu, Lianqing, Han, Zhi
item.description:
来源: hf | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为ViGOS的视觉 grounding 的在线策略自蒸馏框架，用于多模态大语言模型的后训练。

背景: 在线策略自蒸馏在大型语言模型推理中表现良好，但直接扩展到多模态大语言模型时，可能会产生捷径问题，即特权目标主要基于文本参考目标而非图像来指导令牌。

目的: 解决多模态大语言模型中因直接扩展在线策略自蒸馏而产生的捷径问题，提升图像 grounding 行为。

方法: 学生模型首先编写视觉描述，然后推理得出最终答案。对于有效 rollout，仅图像感知教师监督描述，特权推理教师监督推理和最终答案；对于无效 rollout，仅使用参考教师恢复输出格式。

主要发现: ViGOS 在通用视觉语言、专家推理、视觉数学、空间 grounding 和视觉语言先验基准测试中，保持了在线策略自蒸馏的主要优势，并在易产生捷径的设置中改善了图像 grounding 行为。

结论: ViGOS 框架有效解决了多模态大语言模型中的捷径问题，提升了模型在视觉 grounding 方面的表现。

翻译: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) trains a model on its own rollouts and uses a frozen copy to provide dense token-level targets conditioned on a reference target. This works well for LLM reasoning, but a direct extension to multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can create a shortcut: the privileged target may guide tokens mainly based on the text reference target rather than the image. We propose ViGOS, a visually grounded OPSD framework for MLLM post-training. The student first writes a visual description and then reasons toward the final answer. For valid rollouts, an image-only perception teacher supervises the description, while a privileged reasoning teacher supervises the reasoning and final answer on the same student prefix. A reference teacher is used only for invalid rollouts to recover the output format. Across general vision-language, expert reasoning, visual math, spatial grounding, and visual-language-prior benchmarks, ViGOS keeps the main benefits of OPSD and improves image-grounded behavior in shortcut-prone settings.

Abstract

On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) trains a model on its own rollouts and uses a frozen copy to provide dense token-level targets conditioned on a reference target. This works well for LLM reasoning, but a direct extension to multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can create a shortcut: the privileged target may guide tokens mainly based on the text reference target rather than the image. We propose ViGOS, a visually grounded OPSD framework for MLLM post-training. The student first writes a visual description and then reasons toward the final answer. For valid rollouts, an image-only perception teacher supervises the description, while a privileged reasoning teacher supervises the reasoning and final answer on the same student prefix. A reference teacher is used only for invalid rollouts to recover the output format. Across general vision-language, expert reasoning, visual math, spatial grounding, and visual-language-prior benchmarks, ViGOS keeps the main benefits of OPSD and improves image-grounded behavior in shortcut-prone settings.

item.title: HT-Bench: Benchmarking and Learning Dexterous Full-Hand Tactile Representations with Egocentric Vision
item.author: Yuzhe Huang, Jiaping Wu, Jiaming Jiang, Hezhe Lin, Aikebaier Aierken, Yunlong Wang, Kun Cheng, Ziyuan Jiao, Yuanxin Zhong
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出HT-Bench基准和HandTouch编码器，用于评估和提升灵巧操作中的触觉表示学习。

背景: 由于触觉传感器设计、数据格式和机器人形态的多样性，建立通用的触觉表示学习基准具有挑战性。

目的: 探索以自我中心视觉与全手触觉数据配对为方向的可扩展且具前景的未来发展路径。

方法: 构建包含一千万帧RGB图像和七百八十万帧触觉帧的HT-Bench基准，涵盖二百二十六项任务；提出HandTouch编码器，通过渐进式空间、跨模态和时序训练学习触觉表示。

主要发现: HandTouch在HT-Bench上优于现有基线，在细粒度触觉相似度检索、掩码触觉修复和视觉到触觉合成任务上显著提升性能。

结论: 大规模自我中心全手触觉数据为评估和推进灵巧操作中的触觉表示学习提供了可扩展的基础。

翻译: Establishing a universal benchmark for tactile representation learning in robotic manipulation remains challenging due to the diversity of tactile sensor designs, data formats, and robot embodiments. Rather than seeking to establish such, we explore a scalable and promising direction for future development: egocentric vision paired with full-hand tactile data. To this end, we introduce HT-Bench, a large-scale multi-task benchmark for dexterous full-hand tactile sensing, comprising 10M RGB frames and 7.8M tactile frames collected across 226 tasks. HT-Bench evaluates tactile representations from three key perspectives: whether they encode meaningful contact geometry, whether they can align tactile observations with visual information, and whether they generalize to unseen tasks. To assess these capabilities, HT-Bench includes four tasks: fine-grained tactile similarity retrieval, masked tactile inpainting, vision-to-tactile synthesis, and multimodal tactile frame prediction. We further propose HandTouch, a vector-quantized vision-tactile encoder that learns tactile representations through progressive spatial, cross-modal, and temporal training. Across HT-Bench, HandTouch consistently outperforms representative tactile encoder baselines, improving Recall@5 on fine-grained tactile similarity retrieval from 74.65% to 85.23%, reducing RMSE on masked tactile inpainting from 0.022 to 0.010, and increasing OOD cIoU on vision-to-tactile synthesis from 0.628 to 0.705. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of HandTouch and suggest that large-scale egocentric full-hand tactile data provides a scalable basis for evaluating and advancing tactile representation learning in dexterous manipulation.

Abstract

Establishing a universal benchmark for tactile representation learning in robotic manipulation remains challenging due to the diversity of tactile sensor designs, data formats, and robot embodiments. Rather than seeking to establish such, we explore a scalable and promising direction for future development: egocentric vision paired with full-hand tactile data. To this end, we introduce \textbf{HT-Bench}, a large-scale multi-task benchmark for dexterous full-hand tactile sensing, comprising 10M RGB frames and 7.8M tactile frames collected across 226 tasks. HT-Bench evaluates tactile representations from three key perspectives: whether they encode meaningful contact geometry, whether they can align tactile observations with visual information, and whether they generalize to unseen tasks. To assess these capabilities, HT-Bench includes four tasks: fine-grained tactile similarity retrieval, masked tactile inpainting, vision-to-tactile synthesis, and multimodal tactile frame prediction. We further propose \textbf{HandTouch}, a vector-quantized vision--tactile encoder that learns tactile representations through progressive spatial, cross-modal, and temporal training. Across HT-Bench, HandTouch consistently outperforms representative tactile encoder baselines, improving Recall@5 on fine-grained tactile similarity retrieval from 74.65\% to 85.23\%, reducing RMSE on masked tactile inpainting from 0.022 to 0.010, and increasing OOD cIoU on vision-to-tactile synthesis from 0.628 to 0.705. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of HandTouch and suggest that large-scale egocentric full-hand tactile data provides a scalable basis for evaluating and advancing tactile representation learning in dexterous manipulation.

item.title: Beyond the Current Observation: Evaluating Multimodal Large Language Models in Controllable Non-Markov Games
item.author: Shengyuan Ding, Xilin Wei, Xinyu Fang, Haodong Duan, Dahua Lin, Jiaqi Wang, Yuhang Zang
item.description:
来源: arxiv;hf | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出RNG-Bench基准测试套件，用于评估多模态基础模型在需要基于不可见观测进行动作决策的闭环策略中的记忆与重建能力。该基准包含两个互补游戏，通过控制难度轴和引入新协议与指标，揭示了模型在长上下文中的遗忘问题，并展示了微调方法的有效性。

背景: 将多模态基础模型部署为闭环策略时，常需基于不再可见的观测进行动作决策。现有基准测试要么暴露完整状态，要么将隐藏状态重建与其他技能混淆，或仅在回合结束后测试回忆能力。

目的: 隔离并评估基础模型在多步交互中重建过去观测并据此行动的能力。

方法: 提出RNG-Bench基准测试套件，包含Matching Pairs和3D Maze两个游戏。通过统一评估框架控制网格大小、视觉模式和观测模态三个难度轴。引入面对面决斗协议以控制实例级方差，并定义Memory Gap指标以分离遗忘与动作选择错误。使用Qwen3.5-9B模型进行微调实验。

主要发现: 最难的配置需要约128K token上下文和每回合350个图像输入，当前前沿多模态大语言模型远未达到饱和。Memory Gap分析显示，大多数剩余错误源于对早期观测的遗忘，而非次优决策。微调Qwen3.5-9B在最优策略 rollout 和过滤后的模型演示上，提升了在RNG-Bench及现有基准上的性能，且未损害通用多模态能力。

结论: RNG-Bench有效揭示了多模态模型在长上下文记忆方面的局限性，特别是遗忘问题。通过针对性微调可以提升模型在记忆密集型任务中的表现，同时保持通用能力。

翻译: 将多模态基础模型部署为闭环策略越来越需要基于不再可见的观测来调节动作。然而，现有基准测试要么暴露完整状态，要么将隐藏状态重建与其他智能体技能混淆，要么仅在回合结束后测试回忆能力。我们引入了RNG-Bench（重建性非马尔可夫游戏），这是一个旨在隔离基础模型在多步交互中重建过去观测并据此行动能力的基准测试套件。RNG-Bench包含两个互补的游戏：Matching Pairs，其中在特定位置短暂揭示的卡片身份必须在之后回忆；3D Maze，其中第一人称视角必须整合到空间地图中。两个游戏都在一个统一的框架下进行评估，具有三个受控的难度轴：网格大小、视觉模式和观测模态。该基准还引入了面对面对决协议以控制实例级方差，以及Memory Gap指标以将遗忘与次优动作选择分离开来。最难的配置需要大约128K token的上下文和每回合350个图像输入，并且远未达到当前前沿多模态大语言模型的饱和状态。Memory Gap分析表明，大多数剩余错误源于对早期观测的遗忘，而非次优决策。最后，在最优策略 rollout 和过滤后的模型演示上微调Qwen3.5-9B，提高了在RNG-Bench和现有基准上的性能，且未损害通用多模态能力。

Abstract

Deploying multimodal foundation models as closed-loop policies increasingly requires conditioning actions on observations that are no longer visible. However, existing benchmarks either expose the full state, conflate hidden-state reconstruction with other agent skills, or test recall only after an episode has ended. We introduce RNG-Bench (Reconstructive Non-Markov Games), a benchmark suite designed to isolate a base model's ability to reconstruct past observations and act on them during multi-step interaction. RNG-Bench includes two complementary games: Matching Pairs, where card identities briefly revealed at specific locations must later be recalled, and 3D Maze, where egocentric views must be integrated into a spatial map. Both games are evaluated under a unified harness with three controlled difficulty axes: grid size, visual pattern, and observation modality. The benchmark further introduces a head-to-head duel protocol to control for instance-level variance and a Memory Gap metric that disentangles forgetting from poor action selection. The hardest configurations require contexts of roughly 128K tokens and 350 image inputs per episode, and remain far from saturated by frontier MLLMs. Memory Gap analysis shows that most residual errors stem from forgetting earlier observations rather than from suboptimal decision making. Finally, fine-tuning Qwen3.5-9B on optimal-policy rollouts and filtered model demonstrations improves performance on RNG-Bench and transfers to existing benchmarks without degrading general multimodal capability.

item.title: MotionVLA: Vision-Language-Action Model for Humanoid Motion
item.author: Zhang, Nonghai, Zhai, Siyu, Li, Yanjun, Zhang, Zeyu, Yin, Zhihan, Guo, Yandong, Shi, Boxin, Tang, Hao
item.description:
来源: hf | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种双频域标记器DSFT和基于Qwen3.5的运动生成模型MotionVLA，通过将运动分解为基础和物理流并独立压缩，有效解决了现有方法在量化运动信号时的偏差问题，显著提升了生成运动的多样性和条件一致性。

背景: 从场景图像和文本生成逼真的人形运动涉及低频姿态语义和高频物理动态。现有方法通常使用单一共享码本对运动进行标记，导致异构运动信号被强制映射到同一量化空间。

目的: 解决单一码本量化与运动统计之间的不匹配问题，以及标准自回归模型难以有效建模运动序列中高频物理信号的问题。

方法: 提出DSFT双频域标记器，将运动分离为基础流和物理流，并分别使用离散余弦变换截断和字节对编码进行压缩；构建MotionVLA模型，将基础流和物理流标记排列在统一序列中，其中物理流标记在基础流标记之后进行预测。

主要发现: 频域分析显示，五个离散余弦变换系数可捕获百分之九十三的关节位置能量，但仅捕获百分之三十七的关节速度能量，表明单一码本量化会偏向姿态统计而低估高频速度分量。

结论: 频率感知的双流解耦是自回归运动生成的有效方法，MotionVLA在轻量级两亿参数骨干网络下，在HumanML3D数据集上将多样性差距降低超过百分之五十，在MBench数据集上提升运动条件一致性百分之三点八。

翻译: Generating realistic humanoid motion from scene images and text involves both low-frequency pose semantics and high-frequency physical dynamics. However, many existing methods tokenize motion with a single shared codebook, forcing heterogeneous motion signals into the same quantization space. Our frequency-domain analysis of human motion data reveals a clear mismatch between single-codebook quantization and motion statistics: five DCT coefficients capture 93% of joint-position energy but only 37% of joint-velocity energy, which can bias quantization toward pose statistics and under-represent high-frequency velocity components. A second challenge lies in adapting a standard autoregressive model to effectively model high-frequency physical signals in motion sequences. Therefore, we propose DSFT, a dual-stream frequency tokenizer that separates motion into Base and physical streams and compresses them independently with DCT truncation and BPE. Furthermore, we present MotionVLA, a Qwen3.5-based model that arranges Base and physical tokens in a unified sequence, where Phys tokens are predicted after Base tokens. Experiments on HumanML3D and MBench show that, despite using a lightweight 2B backbone, MotionVLA reduces the Diversity gap to real data by over 50% on HumanML3D and improves Motion-Condition Consistency by 3.8% on MBench, supporting frequency-aware dual-stream decoupling as an effective formulation for autoregressive motion generation. Code: this https URL . Website: this https URL .

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 该论文主要解决现有动作生成方法使用单一码本对运动信号进行量化时，无法兼顾低频姿态语义与高频物理动力学特征的问题，导致生成的动作容易出现时间漂移、脚部滑动和关节不稳定等累积误差。这一问题在研究中至关重要，因为精细的人类动作生成是具身智能、角色动画和场景感知动作合成的核心能力，只有准确还原低频姿态与高频物理动态，才能生成逼真且符合物理规律的人体运动。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者通过频域分析发现人类运动数据存在显著差异，关节位置主要为低频信号而关节速度为高频信号。现有方法使用单一码本量化会偏向低频姿态结构，导致高频物理信号丢失并引发动作漂移。为此，作者设计了双流频域分词器，将运动拆分为独立压缩的姿态流与物理流，并在自回归生成时按顺序排列，使模型能先理解姿态再预测物理动态。该方法借鉴了频域分析在长序列生成中的优势以及现有的视觉语言动作建模框架，但针对单一码本的结构缺陷提出了全新的解耦设计。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 核心思想是将人体运动按频率特性解耦为姿态语义和物理动力学两条独立流，分别进行离散化编码，以解决传统单一流编码对高频速度信息保留不足的问题。整体流程首先将场景图像和文本指令输入模型，接着通过双频域分词器将运动数据拆分为姿态和速度流并转换为离散符号。随后模型按顺序先生成姿态符号再生成速度符号，最后将生成的符号还原并拼接，输出完整的人体运动序列。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的核心创新是提出了一种双流频域分词机制，将人体运动按频率特性拆分为低频的姿态语义和高频的物理动力学两部分，并分别进行独立压缩与编码。与以往工作使用单一共享码本统一量化所有运动信号的做法不同，该方法有效避免了低频姿态信息对高频速度细节的掩盖。此外，模型将两部分令牌按顺序整合到统一的自回归生成流程中，先构建姿态框架再补充物理动态，从而显著提升了长序列生成的稳定性并减少了滑步等累积误差。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文提出了一种双频域流标记器与自回归生成框架，通过将人体运动解耦为低频姿态语义和高频物理动态两个独立流进行压缩与生成，有效克服了传统单码本量化导致的物理信号丢失问题，显著提升了动作生成的多样性与物理一致性。

Abstract

Generating realistic humanoid motion from scene images and text involves both low-frequency pose semantics and high-frequency physical dynamics. However, many existing methods tokenize motion with a single shared codebook, forcing heterogeneous motion signals into the same quantization space. Our frequency-domain analysis of human motion data reveals a clear mismatch between single-codebook quantization and motion statistics: five DCT coefficients capture 93% of joint-position energy but only 37% of joint-velocity energy, which can bias quantization toward pose statistics and under-represent high-frequency velocity components. A second challenge lies in adapting a standard autoregressive model to effectively model high-frequency physical signals in motion sequences. Therefore, we propose DSFT, a dual-stream frequency tokenizer that separates motion into Base and physical streams and compresses them independently with DCT truncation and BPE. Furthermore, we present MotionVLA, a Qwen3.5-based model that arranges Base and physical tokens in a unified sequence, where Phys tokens are predicted after Base tokens. Experiments on HumanML3D and MBench show that, despite using a lightweight 2B backbone, MotionVLA reduces the Diversity gap to real data by over 50% on HumanML3D and improves Motion-Condition Consistency by 3.8% on MBench, supporting frequency-aware dual-stream decoupling as an effective formulation for autoregressive motion generation. item.title: ParkingTransformer: LLM-Enhanced End-to-End Trajectory Planning for Autonomous Parking
item.author: Hauteng Wu, Xu Li, Dong Kong, Zihang Wang, Xieyuanli Chen, Benwu Wang, Wenkai Zhu
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为ParkingTransformer的新型端到端自动泊车框架，该框架利用多视图感知和大语言模型的场景理解能力，通过结合轨迹查询与大语言模型隐式状态特征，直接与历史信息和原始传感器数据交互以输出规划轨迹，无需密集鸟瞰图表示。为解决大语言模型空间推理能力不足的问题，引入了三维位置编码以显式注入空间几何感知。此外，设计了固定窗口流机制处理历史信息，提高了长期时间处理效率和推理速度，并采用由粗到细的解码策略逐步提升轨迹精度。在CARLA仿真器和真实车辆平台上的闭环实验验证了该方法的可行性和有效性。

背景: 端到端自动泊车是自动驾驶领域的一项关键任务。然而，现有方法存在黑盒特性，缺乏高层语义理解和可解释性，阻碍了从道路到目标车位的无缝长距离自动泊车的实现。

目的: 解决现有自动泊车方法的黑盒特性、缺乏高层语义理解和可解释性的问题，实现从道路到目标车位的无缝长距离自动泊车。

方法: 提出ParkingTransformer框架，利用多视图感知和大语言模型的场景理解能力；结合轨迹查询与大语言模型隐式状态特征，直接与历史信息和原始传感器数据交互输出规划轨迹，避免使用密集鸟瞰图表示；引入三维位置编码以弥补大语言模型空间推理能力的不足；设计固定窗口流机制处理历史信息以提高效率；采用由粗到细的解码策略提升轨迹精度。

主要发现: 在CARLA仿真器中实现了61.32的驾驶分数；在真实世界实验中平均成功率达到88.70%。

结论: 所提出的算法在可行性和有效性方面得到了验证，能够解决现有方法的局限性，实现高效的自动泊车。

翻译: End-to-end autonomous parking has emerged as a critical task within the realm of autonomous driving. However, existing methods suffer from black-box characteristics, lacking high-level semantic understanding and interpretability, which impedes the realization of seamless long-distance autonomous parking from the road to the target spot. To address these limitations, we propose ParkingTransformer, a novel framework that leverages multi-view perception and the scene understanding capability of Large Language Models (LLMs). By combining trajectory queries with LLMs implicit state features, our method interacts directly with historical information and raw sensor data to output planning trajectories, eliminating the need for dense Bird's-View (BEV) representations. To compensate for the inadequate spatial reasoning ability of LLMs, we introduce 3D positional encoding to explicitly inject spatial geometric awareness. Furthermore, a fixed-window streaming mechanism is designed for historical information processing, significantly improving long-term temporal processing efficiency and inference speed. Additionally, a coarse-to-fine decoding strategy is employed to progressively enhance trajectory precision. Extensive closed-loop experiments are conducted on the CARLA simulator and real-world vehicle platforms. The results demonstrate that our method achieves a driving score of 61.32 in CARLA simulator and an average success rate of 88.70% in real-world experiments, validating the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed algorithms.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 该论文主要解决现有自动泊车方法计算开销大、缺乏高层语义理解与可解释性，以及大语言模型空间几何推理能力不足的问题。该问题在研究和现实中至关重要，因为实现从道路到目标车位的长距离无缝自动泊车是自动驾驶落地的关键需求，而传统模块化架构存在误差累积，现有端到端方法又难以兼顾高效计算、场景理解与轨迹精度。解决该问题有助于提升泊车系统的可靠性、可解释性与实际部署效率。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: Here's a thinking process:1. **Analyze User Input:** - **Role:** Academic paper reading assistant. - **Task:** Read and analyze the provided paper content, answer "one" question. - **Question:** 作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？ (How did the authors think about and design this method? Did they draw inspiration from existing work?) - **Constraints:** - Use concise, accurate, plain Chinese. - Avoid formulas, symbols, or abbreviations. - If not explicitly stated, write "unknown". - Keep it short (2-4 sentences), no long lists, no arrays/nested objects. - Output ONLY the answer text (no JSON, markdown, code blocks, extra explanations). - Base answer strictly on the provided text.2. **Scan Paper for Keywords/Concepts related to the Question:** - *Question parts:* How they thought/designed it?
